tools.name: get_default_policy
tools.description: Get the default policy document. Save it as hotpath/policy.toml (or hotpath/<benchmark>-policy.toml), edit it, then check it with validate_policy.

tools.name: get_diff
tools.description: Compare a report with its baseline, as the PR comment does: regressions, improvements and broken budgets. Read the top-level `verdict` first.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Fetch one report: its summary, verdict and policy, optionally with its hotpath JSON payload. not_found means CI has not uploaded it yet. For what changed against the baseline, use get_diff.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: List a repository's reports, newest first, as summaries with their run totals. Use it to browse report history; with `select`, to follow given entities across runs.

tools.name: list_repos
tools.description: List the repositories with the hotpath GitHub App installed, with their benchmarks. Start here: `full_name` is the `repo` argument of the other tools.

tools.name: validate_policy
tools.description: Check a policy TOML document. Use it after editing a policy file, before committing it.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show the GitHub user and API token this connection acts as. Use it to check the connection or after an invalid_token error.
